the motion inputs for hip joint simulators can be simplified to the ISO standard motion or a ProSim hip simulator condition, which is a simplified motion of the walking cycle, and the wear predictions based on these two motion conditions were comparable to that of a full walking cycle.

the wear performance of the hip joint can be accurately predicted using a new wear model and the simplified motions, including ProSim simulator motion, can be used to simulate the wear performance of hip joint implants in vivo.
the simplified motion conditions can be used as an alternative for full simulated walking condition in wear prediction of artificial joints.
